notes.title: Football Mogul 16 (latest version) is on sale on our site!
notes.notes:
If you've been enjoying [i]Football Mogul 2014[/i] or have been interested in a football simulator, be sure to check out our site for the latest installment to the [i]Football Mogul[/i] series.

Several new features include:

(1) Updated team rosters for 2015-2016 season
(2) Added the ability to save and resume games during Play-By-Play mode
(3) Added "Point Spread" and "Over/Under" information to the Calendar page
(4) Added "Power Rank" to the Finances Page
(5) And much, much, more...

Be sure to checkout the game on our store page (link below) for all the listed features!

If you'd like to see [b]Football Mogul 16[/b] on Steam, be sure to up vote the game on [i]Greenlight[/i] (coming shortly).

Link for [b]Football Mogul 16[/b]: http://sportsmogul.com/games/football16.html
